caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piano with a closed lid, primarily colored in rich brown hues resembling polished wood. The front panel above the keys features a gold decorative motif and a central rectangular plaque. The keyboard consists of alternating white and black keys. The piano has six elaborately turned legs, each with spiral grooves and gold-colored accents near the top and bottom, ending in small metal caster wheels. There are two small drawers on the front with round, gold-colored knobs. The background is plain, and the artist’s signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Piano
